title: Keep full-launch ambiguity when an exit is unknown or the start closes unended
outcome: A later mediated gate cannot attribute an earlier still-running full run to itself after an unknown detached exit or an unended authorized launch closes; actual nonzero failures remain distinguished.
acceptance: Deterministic tests reproduce the same-owner/same-root run-association gap for Unknown detached exit and for an authorized full start closed unended.
Possibly running launches retain a bounded original root/start window; observed nonzero exit policy is distinguished explicitly and matching ordinary carries retain liveness.
